lua: assert(settings.bar.locked and settings.bar.x==100 and settings.bar.y==400, 'An explicitly locked free bar moved'); MOCK.fire('command', {command='/momentum free',blocked=false})
assert(not settings.bar.locked, 'Free command left movement locked')
assert(settings.bar.x==150 and settings.bar.y==320 and not settings.bar.docked, 'Unlocked free bar did not follow Shift-drag'); settings.bar.hide_typing=false

assert(settings.bar.x==150 and settings.bar.y==320, 'A click without Shift moved the free bar'); assert(not require('imgui').GetIO().WantCaptureMouse, 'Free bar captured an ordinary mouse click'); MOCK.typing=true

assert(settings.bar.x==150 and settings.bar.y==320, 'Typing did not suppress Shift-drag'); assert(not require('imgui').GetIO().WantCaptureMouse, 'Typing did not preserve mouse pass-through'); MOCK.typing=false; MOCK.fire('command', {command='/momentum undo',blocked=false})
assert(settings.bar.x==100 and settings.bar.y==400 and not settings.bar.locked, 'Undo did not restore the completed drag as one edit')
